name: TrueSeller Verified Reviews for WooCommerce
author: trueseller

sections.description:
Reviews shoppers trust. TrueSeller Reviews collects reviews from customers who really bought, shows them on your shop and prepares data for Google. When someone rates low, it helps you resolve the issue with the customer before they leave.

What makes TrueSeller Reviews different

  • Resolve a bad review with the customer. A customer who rates low gets an offer of contact, and you reply from the panel using ready templates. When the issue is solved, the customer can update the review, and the review shows it was changed after talking to the shop.
  • Google Shopping feed included. A product reviews feed for Google Merchant Center at no extra cost. You paste its address once, without giving us access to your Google account.
  • No review limit, no paid add-ons. All features from day one, including a review reminder.
  • Rules shoppers trust. “Verified purchase” only for real orders. A plain average of all published reviews. Only the author can change a review. A review can be rejected only for a clear reason from a fixed list based on Google’s review policies, with a reason given, an appeal and a decision log.
  • Consent, your way. By default a review request goes only to customers who agreed: one click on the order confirmation page or a checkbox at checkout. We store the exact consent text they saw. You can also send requests to all buyers. The choice is yours.
  • Lightweight script. It loads in the background, with no extra libraries or fonts, so it does not hold up your pages, also on mobile.
  • Moving without loss. Bring reviews from your previous system in a CSV or Excel file, with their original dates, duplicates skipped and a preview before saving. Moved reviews are labelled, so shoppers know where they come from.

How it works

A review request goes out the number of days you choose after the order is completed (with a read-only WooCommerce API key) or after it is placed. One request and at most one reminder, during the day, from your shop’s own mailbox, with your logo and the products from the order. The customer clicks a star and rates the product and the shop in one form. Topic hints and your own questions help them write something specific, and they can add up to three photos.

Stars under the product name, on product lists and a store badge appear by themselves. Use shortcodes for the review list, the carousel and the store rating anywhere else. On product pages with reviews the plugin adds review structured data; Google decides when to show stars in search results. Moved reviews are labelled “Moved from …”, do not count toward the average and are never sent to Google, as Google does not accept reviews syndicated from other sources. You can move reviews dated before you added your shop, within 90 days. All reviews can be exported to CSV.

This plugin connects your WordPress site to your TrueSeller account. You set everything else — look, texts, opening hours, emails — in the TrueSeller panel, without touching your site again.

The TrueSeller apps for live chat, reviews and abandoned carts share one account and one shop key. Install the ones you need: the script is loaded only once.

What you need

  • A TrueSeller account (paid service, see trueseller.pl)
  • WooCommerce

External services

This plugin connects your site to TrueSeller, a service run by the plugin author, which provides TrueSeller Reviews.

When a shop key is saved, every page of your site loads the TrueSeller script from https://app.truechat.pl/widget.js. The script sends to app.truechat.pl the address of the page being viewed, the product shown on it, and — on the order confirmation page — the order number and the visitor’s consent to receive a review request; reviews and photos the customer submits are sent from the TrueSeller review form. Which data is sent depends on the modules and options you turn on in the TrueSeller panel. Nothing is sent before you save a shop key.

  • Terms of service: https://trueseller.pl/regulamin/
  • Privacy policy: https://trueseller.pl/prywatnosc/

You, as the shop owner, decide about your customers’ data; TrueSeller processes it on your behalf. Mention TrueSeller in your shop’s privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Log in to the TrueSeller panel, go to Settings → Add to your shop and copy the code or the key.
  3. In the same place add your shop address to “Shop addresses”.
  4. In WordPress open Settings → TrueSeller Reviews, paste the code or the key and save.
sections.faq:
Is the plugin free?

The plugin is free. TrueSeller Reviews itself is a paid TrueSeller service; the plugin does nothing without an account.

Will it slow my site down?

No. The script is small and loads asynchronously in the footer, after your page. Larger parts load only when they are needed.

I use more than one TrueSeller app.

Install each plugin you need. They share one key, so you paste it once, and the script is added to the page only once.

Where do I change the look and texts?

In the TrueSeller panel. The plugin only connects your site to your account.

How do I show reviews outside product pages?

Use the shortcodes [trueseller_reviews product="123"], [trueseller_stars product="123"], [trueseller_store_rating] and [trueseller_carousel]. On WooCommerce product pages reviews and stars appear without shortcodes.

I use a plugin that speeds up my site. Do I need to change anything?

LiteSpeed Cache, WP Rocket, Perfmatters and Autoptimize: no, the plugin excludes the TrueSeller script from script delaying by itself. In other plugins that delay or combine JavaScript (for example FlyingPress), add app.truechat.pl/widget.js to the list of excluded scripts.

Where can I get help?

Email kontakt@trueseller.pl or use the live chat at trueseller.pl.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • Fix: reviews list also on product pages without tabs (no description, WooCommerce reviews hidden), e.g. with the Storefront theme.
  • Fix: the TrueSeller script is excluded from script delaying in LiteSpeed Cache, WP Rocket, Perfmatters and Autoptimize, so stars and the review request show without waiting for the visitor to move the mouse.
  • Fix: order confirmation page recognised also when its address was renamed in WooCommerce settings or permalinks are plain.

1.1.0

  • New: hides the built-in WooCommerce reviews tab and form while the shop is connected, so product pages show one review section (Settings → TrueSeller Reviews; on by default, existing WooCommerce reviews are kept).

1.0.0

  • First version.
